# technitium_cluster (Resource)

Initializes a cluster with this server as the Primary node. Initializing renames the server to `<host>.<cluster_domain>` and enables HTTPS (self-signed if none is configured), and creates the cluster zones; don't manage `dns_server_domain` or web service TLS in settings resources at the same time. Destroying deletes the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_cluster" "this" {
  cluster_domain = "dns.example.com"
  ip_addresses   = ["192.168.1.2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_domain` (String) Cluster domain name. Cannot be changed after initialization.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) This node's addresses reachable by the other nodes.

### Optional

- `config_refresh_interval` (Number) Seconds between config syncs on Secondary nodes (30-3600).
- `config_retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between config sync retries (30-3600).
- `force_delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) On destroy, delete the cluster even if Secondary nodes remain (orphaning them).
- `heartbeat_refresh_interval` (Number) Seconds between node state refreshes (10-300).
- `heartbeat_retry_interval` (Number) Seconds between retries after a failed refresh (10-300).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster domain.
- `nodes` (List of Object) Cluster nodes: `id`, `name`, `url`, `ip_addresses`, `type` (`Primary`/`Secondary`), `state`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `server_domain` (String) This server's name in the cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_cluster.this cluster
```
